author: agent
sentences: My newsletter had its second birthday this month.
Every Sunday it goes out to 14,000 subscribers.
For a long time the open rate was 26 percent, and then it went up to 52 percent when I cut each issue in half.
Shorter is kinder to your readers.
I also stopped sending links I had not read myself.

expected.say: 26 percent, and then it went up to 52 percent

notes: FromTo with a change verb (went up to), percent to percent; a subscriber count over 1,000. second in sentence 1 is not a list marker
